page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading "AD LECTOREM." at top centre; closing lines and signature centred below the text; catchword "COM-" at lower right. No page number printed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page in the middle and lower area, not transcribed.

main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: demque Princeps pacis, Spiritu suo ducat vos per orbitas sapientiæ, sanctimoniæ, & charitatis ; atque in veritate sua sanctificet ; Studia denique vestra, omnesque in iis labores, ad multorum ædificationem salutarem, suique nominis sanctissimi gloriam sempiternam, dirigat ac gubernet! Sic spero, & voveo qui
Dabam Ultraj. in museo meo, ipsis Kal. Octobr. A. D. clɔ Iɔc Lxviii.

page.notes: Paragraph of the text runs over at "qui" with the sentence continuing on the next page. The dating line uses the old reversed-C numeral form, rendered as MDCLXVIII; the printed form is cIↄ Iↄ c Lxviii. The line "Dabam Ultraj. in museo meo" has a damaged letter ("mufeo" in print). Show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
